description: JEE Mains + Advanced style benchmark for SPIRAL. Verified reference keys; mix of MCQ and numeric-value questions across mechanics, electromagnetism, thermodynamics, optics, modern physics, physical/organic/inorganic chemistry, and mathematics. Graded by scripts/bench_jee.py using app.answer_check.check_answer.
